changes.catalogue-fields: LTspice's catalogue fields (mfg=, Vceo=, …) removed: ngspice refuses them, the others ignore them
changes.renamed: the .model renamed DUT, the name the bench's netlists use

ngspice:
* spec 1
.include "model.lib"

.options reltol=1e-4
.temp 25
VC0 c0 0 5
BB0 0 b0 I=exp(2.302585092994046*V(x))
Q0 c0 b0 0 DUT
BSB0 0 bs0 I=exp(2.302585092994046*V(x))
BSC0 0 cs0 I=20*exp(2.302585092994046*V(x))
DCL0 cs0 cl0 DCLMP
VCL0 cl0 0 30
QS0 cs0 bs0 0 DUT
VX x 0 0
RX x 0 1
.model DCLMP D(Is=1e-14)
.dc VX -9 -0.5 0.02
.end
* spec 2
.include "model.lib"

.options reltol=1e-4
.temp 25
V1 a 0 DC 10 AC 1
VB b 0 0
RE e 0 1e12
Q1 a b e DUT
.save I(V1)
.ac dec 20 1e3 1e8
.end
* spec 3
.include "model.lib"

.options reltol=1e-4
.temp 25
V1 a 0 DC 0.5 AC 1
VB b 0 0
RC cc 0 1e12
Q1 cc b a DUT
.save I(V1)
.ac dec 20 1e3 1e8
.end
* spec 4
.include "model.lib"

.options reltol=1e-4
.temp 25
VCT ct 0 5
IBT 0 bt DC 1.90462644e-05 AC 1
QT ct bt 0 DUT
.save I(VCT)
.ac dec 40 100 1e10
.end
* spec 5
.include "model.lib"

.options reltol=1e-4
.temp 25
VSENSE c cc 0
VC cc 0 5
IB 0 b DC 3.94102175e-07
VIN in 0 DC 0.622010963 AC 1
RG in b 2000
Q1 c b 0 DUT
H1 out 0 VSENSE 1000
RLOAD out 0 1meg
.noise V(out) VIN dec 20 1 1e6
.end
